primarySources.finding: The metric reports matching begin/end signpost regions; no matching pair yields no result.
Current built-in metric measures scroll dragging and deceleration; visionOS compatibility restriction does not describe this iOS Simulator run.
Apple demonstrates swipeUp(.fast) then stopMeasuring() before resetting scroll position. Immediate stop is not itself evidence of misuse.

recommendation.productionChange: None justified by current evidence. Keep required metric, five samples, thresholds and warning/skip rules unchanged.
recommendation.nextBoundedDiagnostic: On one fresh task-owned simulator matching hosted Xcode 26.3/iOS 26.2, execute the same selected scroll test once as a separate diagnostic, with exact Date timestamps immediately around startMeasuring/stopMeasuring retained outside the measured block, plus scoped XCTest collector logs. Compare UIKit begin/end pairs against the inner confirmed measurement window. Preserve result whether pass or fail; do not replace original acceptance evidence.
recommendation.decisionRule: If actual signpost endpoints fall outside measurement boundaries, address the observed boundary with a supported synchronization condition. If complete pairs are inside but absent from XCTest, isolate collector behavior in a minimal reproduction and retain this release gate failed pending a measured, verified remedy.
